description: This file defines a PDF processing class that extracts text and images from PDF documents, chunking text into manageable segments and saving images locally.

classes.name: PDFProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing PDF files to extract text and images, with methods for chunking text and saving images.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PDFProcessor, setting up the images directory.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Processes a PDF file to extract text chunks and images, returning them as lists of dictionaries.

methods.name: _chunk_text
methods.description: Splits extracted text into chunks with overlap based on size settings.
